summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container per the spec. Changes: sparql.py adds Update(prologue, algebra); algebra.py translateUpdate always returns an Update (empty path applies translatePrologue to q.prologue[0] with base and initNs and returns Update(prologue, []); non-empty path returns Update(prologue, res)); update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container; processor.py adds prepareUpdate beside prepareQuery (with _original_args) and the update processor needed no change; __init__.py exports prepareUpdate; test/test_sparql_prepare.py added with tests for each required behavior. Not run: per instructions I did not execute tests or black. Unverified: the initial-bindings test assumes an empty WHERE yields one solution; line lengths were checked by hand. No commits made.
